mn132:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn132:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejesi sampahaṃseti; bhaddekaratassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca bhāsati.
mn132:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn132:2.4: Ko nu kho, bhikkhave, upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsīti?
mn132:2.5: Āyasmā, bhante, Ānando upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsīti.
mn132:2.6: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn132:2.7: Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsīti?
mn132:3.1: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsiṃ:--
mn132:4.2: Evarūpo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, . . . (&c.,
mn132:9.8: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
mn132:11.1: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsin ti.
mn132:11.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi; bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsi.
mn132:13-19.8: Evaṃ kho, Ānanda, anāgataṃ na paṭikaṅkhati.
mn132:13-19.9: Kathañ c', Ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati? --pe--.
mn132:13-19.10: Evaṃ kho, Ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
mn132:13-19.11: Kathañ c', Ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati? --pe--.
mn132:13-19.12: Evaṃ kho, Ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhirati.
mn132:13-19.18: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 133.
